build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with parameterized step_diff and jar_scale values
add_static_bar: create a static bar object with configurable scale, bottom position, and left offset in the scene
add_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object with configurable scale, bottom position, and left offset in the scene
update_task_relationships: update the task to require two bodies to be in a TOUCHING spatial relationship
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to BALL solution tier using C.set_meta with SolutionTier enum
